places.name: Paradise Beach
places.blurb: Take a short boat ride across the backwaters to reach this pristine stretch of golden sand.

places.name: Auroville
places.blurb: Explore this experimental global township dedicated to human unity and sustainable living.

places.name: Promenade Beach
places.blurb: Enjoy scenic evening strolls along the rocky coastline in the heart of the French Quarter.

places.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
places.blurb: Seek spiritual peace at the flower-covered samadhi of Sri Aurobindo and The Mother.

places.name: Puducherry Museum
places.blurb: Discover ancient bronzes, Chola art, and French colonial artifacts.

places.name: Matrimandir
places.blurb: Admire the magnificent golden globe dedicated to concentrated meditation in Auroville.

places.name: Gingee Fort
places.blurb: Trek up one of the most impregnable hill fortresses in India built across three steep hills.

places.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
places.blurb: Marvel at the 8th-century structural rock temples overlooking the Bay of Bengal.

places.name: Brihadeeswarar Temple
places.blurb: Witness the grand architectural masterpiece of the Chola dynasty and a UNESCO World Heritage site.

places.name: Yercaud Lake
places.blurb: Boat on the tranquil, tree-fringed waters of this pleasant Shevaroy hill station retreat.
